prompt:
Locked-off camera. The older man in the brown tweed jacket, check shirt and green knitted tie sits on a Windsor chair, centre, facing the camera, his right hand on his chest; a pint stands on the round table at frame right and an olive sleeve and hand reach across the table in the foreground. He lowers his hand from his chest, leans in toward the table a little, brow furrowed, and says "So they wanted both?" puzzled, at a brisk natural pace, then stops and waits for an answer, eyebrows raised. Only his mouth moves for words; the foreground hand stays still. Same room, same warm lamp light, only the people already in the frame, the picture clean. Small, real pub performance; photographic.
Thanks.
